records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Kai,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no first project and no key milestone; account has never replied to either outreach ([email:25853b52], [email:d61b8b0e]) and filed no tickets, so engagement signal is weak. One invite sent shows some intent, so not negligible, but Starter self-serve accounts silent at day 6 often don't reach activation in 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Thanks for getting started with Wrenfield, and I see you've already sent an invite to a teammate.

The next step that tends to make everything click is your first project -- in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm happy to walk it with you.

Would a short call this week work? I can help you map your current work into a first project so your teammate has something to land in.

Best,
Chidi
